segments.name: Seed and integrated products
segments.description: Develops and commercializes seed technologies and products that raise yield per hectare, integrated with crop protection and nutrition.
segments.evidence: The seed and integrated products segment focuses mainly on the development and commercialization of seed technologies and products that increase yield per hectare

segments.name: Crop protection
segments.description: Sells crop protection products, including adjuvants and bioprotection, to farmers and agricultural companies.
segments.evidence: These external pressures significantly impacted per-hectare income for Argentine farmers, leading to reduced investment in key inputs such as fertilizers and crop protection products.

segments.name: Crop nutrition
segments.description: Sells inoculants, biofertilizers, micro-beaded fertilizers and biostimulants that optimize crop productivity and yield.
segments.evidence: Currently the segment generates income from ordinary activities through the sale of inoculants, bio-inductors, biological fertilizers and microgranulated fertilizers, among others.

revenueModel.text: Farmers, distributors and agricultural companies pay for seed, crop protection and crop nutrition products sold to them.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers include multinational and local agricultural companies, distributors, and farmers who purchase the Group's products.

changes.text: In 2026 the Pro Farm business was lost in a judicial foreclosure sale.
changes.evidence: On January 20, 2026, a judicial foreclosure sale of granted collateral took place, resulting in the loss of the Pro Farm business
